name: Chapter Route - SF & Bay Area
description: The West Coast chapter, rendering through the same route as every other. Its page needed no code — publishing the markdown entry produced the page, the menu link and the card. It now also carries a named lead and one tagged event, and because that event has passed it demonstrates the pairing an active chapter most often shows in practice: leads present, nothing upcoming, and a Recent events block carrying the proof that the chapter is real.
